messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

message.content:
**Tesla Model S – Current Status in India** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Official Availability** | As of May 2026, Tesla does *not* sell cars directly through its own retail network in India. There’s no confirmed launch window or set‑up of service centers yet. | | **Price Information** | Because the vehicle isn’t officially listed, there is no published MSRP (Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price) from Tesla for Indian customers. Any figure you see online will be speculative—often derived from U.S./European prices adjusted for local taxes and shipping costs. | | **What You Can Do If Interested** | 1. **Contact Tesla Support:** Reach out via the global website or your nearest regional office (e.g., Tesla Europe/US) asking whether they plan to ship to India and what the expected cost would be.
2. **Check Importers & Dealerships:** Some third‑party import specialists occasionally bring Teslas into India under “special license” arrangements. These usually involve hefty customs duty (~30–40 % + VAT/GST), registration fees, and compliance modifications, pushing the total cost well above $100k USD (≈₹8–9 crore INR).
3. **Wait for Official Launch:** Tesla has hinted at exploring the Indian market, citing high demand and favorable EV incentives. Keep an eye on press releases around Q4 2027 when many analysts expect a formal entry. | --- ### Rough Cost Estimate (If Imported) Below is a ballpark calculation using the U.S. MSRP ($129,990 for the Long Range variant) converted to ₹INR: | Component | Approximate Value | |-----------|-------------------| | Base MSRP (USD) | $129,990 | | Exchange Rate (USD→INR)* | ~₹82 per $ → ₹10,679,180 | | Customs Duty (35%) | ₹3,738,313 | | Integrated Goods & Services Tax (IGST 18%) | ₹1,922,744 | | Registration / Compliance Fees | ₹200,000+ | | Total Estimated Cost | ≈ ₹16–17 million INR (₹160–170 lakh) | \*Exchange rates fluctuate daily; use real-time data for precise conversion. --- #### Bottom Line Until Tesla announces an official launch in India, there is no definitive price list. For anyone seriously considering purchasing a Model S in India today, it involves navigating complex import regulations and paying significantly higher than the U.S. price due to tariffs and taxes. Stay tuned to Tesla’s announcements and consult reputable import experts if you’re looking to buy one before an official rollout.
